=> < deviceB | 'buttonPressed' : true , ... > .
[B2] < deviceB | 'buttonPressed' : true , 'key' : nils , ... > $ UserX 'sendKey' deviceB | Key
=> < deviceB | 'buttonPressed' : false , 'key' : Key , ... > .
[B3] < deviceB | 'key' : Key , ... > $ UserX 'discover' deviceB
=> < deviceB | 'key' : Key , ... > $ deviceB 'bind' cloudA | Key if Key =/= nils .
[B3] < cloudA | UserY : ('accountKey' : Key , ...) , deviceB : ('owner' : nils , ...) , ... > $ deviceB 'bind' cloudA | Key
=> < cloudA | UserY : ('accountKey' : Key , ...) , deviceB : ('owner' : UserY , ...) , ... > .
[B4] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'approach' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : deviceB , ... > .
[B5] < UserX | 'near' : OldNear , ... > $ UserX 'leave' deviceB
=> < UserX | 'near' : nils , ... > .
